_note: Candidate registry for Ohio 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Ohio Secretary of State, Directive 2026-45, Form of the Official Ballot for the November 3, 2026, General Election, section VI Candidates Certified by the Secretary of State (August 25, 2026); U.S. House lists from the filing county boards of elections named per race, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Ohio Secretary of State, Directive 2026-45, Form of the Official Ballot for the November 3, 2026, General Election, section VI Candidates Certified by the Secretary of State (August 25, 2026); U.S. House lists from the filing county boards of elections named per race (https://www.ohiosos.gov/assets/dir2026-45-form-of-the-official-ballot-for-the-november%203-general-election.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
